question: Whom do I notify after a security incident and how quickly?
answer: Security incidents must be reported to security@acme.example within 1 hour of discovery. [1] The on-call security engineer triages incidents and opens a post-mortem within 5 business days. [1] Priority 1 tickets (complete outage, security issue) receive a response within 30 minutes. [2]
